text: At a critical point where ∇f = 0, the nature of the extremum (minimum, maximum, or saddle) is classified by the signs of the eigenvalues of the ___ matrix of second partial derivatives.
explanation: The Hessian matrix [∂²f/∂xⁱ∂xʲ] is symmetric by Clairaut's theorem; at a critical point, all-positive eigenvalues give a local minimum, all-negative a maximum, and mixed signs a saddle point — the second derivative test. The Jacobian (first derivatives) vanishes at a critical point and therefore cannot make this classification.
